Merges the current master into the approved branch so it is no longer behind. The merge applies cleanly and only brings in the upstream README and envd dependency changes; the `logger` import fix and its two regression cases are unchanged.

Slurm plugin tests after the merge: `pytest plugins/flytekit-slurm/tests` gives 4 passed. With the import removed, both regression cases fail with `NameError`.

The red `integration` job is a `FlyteTimeout` in `test_remote.py`, a file this PR does not touch.

Disclosure: this follow-up was prepared with an AI coding assistant (Codex and Claude Code) and submitted by the account owner.
@pcbeingused333 would you be open to try the V2 connector for Slurm? https://github.com/flyteorg/flyte-sdk/tree/main/plugins/slurm

Thanks for pointing to the V2 Slurm connector. This PR only fixes a missing `logger` import in the v1 function task connector in flytekit, so it stands on its own. Happy to look at the flyte-sdk plugin as a separate piece of work if you'd like; is there a specific gap there you'd want covered, or an issue to start from?
